acc: Where a board source (AnKing card, UWorld, NBME) and a guideline differ, the brief teaches the board answer and puts the guideline in an "In practice:" hover (runbook section 3): the hover is intended, not a finding.
Word counts are not judged (2026-10-19 layers rule: nothing is cut for length).
Hubs (cholestasis, occult-gi-bleed) stop after Workup and hand off by drawer; treatment by cause sits inside Workup (s148 hub rule). Steps 5 to 8 absent in a hub is not a finding.
L facts (the old brief's own lines) are a valid source for carried content.

Lines carried with the unverified mark because they are board-tested and no source opened today states them (judge their accuracy for Step 2, not the marking choice): fap any-age colectomy triggers "bleeding" and "a polyp larger than 1 cm" (live L06, L25; bank q_a07d, q_da6e, q_a6d9); zenker "a blind scope or nasogastric tube can perforate the pouch" (live L05, L21; bank q_899c, q_0761; MSD Esophageal Diverticula is silent).

Lead calls (judge accuracy, not the choice): liver-preg teaches intrahepatic cholestasis delivery at 37 weeks (AnKing) with 36 weeks at bile acids 100 micromol/L or more in In practice (MSD, ACOG/SMFM), and writes MSD's platelets under 100 x 10^9/L as 100,000 per microliter; masld teaches the diagnosis as one of exclusion (board) with the 2023 positive criteria and pioglitazone, vitamin E and metformin in In practice hovers; cholestasis teaches PSC as men, young to middle-aged, with inflammatory bowel disease (AnKing) and PBC second line as "a second agent if the response is poor"; fap teaches prophylactic proctocolectomy in the teens to early 20s unless a trigger is met (AnKing) and post-colectomy upper endoscopy at periodic intervals (MSD) with the ACG ages in a hover; bs-impaction ischemic colitis row rests on live L12.

Item rewritten with a version bump: bs-impaction q_56636eea25ad v2, key changed from "Disimpaction + methylnaltrexone or naloxegol" to "Disimpaction, then a scheduled stimulant or osmotic laxative" (AnKing high-yield line: first-line therapy is a scheduled osmotic or stimulant laxative; MSD keeps PAMORAs for constipation that does not resolve with other measures; the stem names no failed laxative). Judge it as an item.
